title: Nubia NaviX Ultra Scheduled for Release on September 16th, Equipped with Doubao Mobile Assistant
excerpt: Nubia officially announced today that the world's first AI Agent smartphone, the Nubia NaviX Ultra, will be officially released on September 16th at 14:00. The
content_html:
Nubia officially announced today that the world's first AI Agent smartphone, the Nubia NaviX Ultra, will be officially released on September 16th at 14:00. The device was jointly developed by ZTE and ByteDance, and is equipped with the Doubao Mobile Assistant, known as the "second generation of Doubao Mobile."

Previously, it was reported that the NaviX Ultra would adjust its cooperation methods with super apps such as Alibaba and Tencent, no longer using a GUI approach where the user grants permission to read the screen, simulate clicks, and operate the application. The way the AI agent interacts with mobile applications may further change.

In terms of hardware, the new device is expected to be equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen5 flagship processor, a 7000mAh silicon carbon negative battery, and support for 90W/100W wired fast charging and wireless charging; the imaging system is expected to use a 50MP main camera, ultra-wide angle, and a periscope telephoto lens, with a front-facing 50MP high-resolution camera.

On September 4th, Nubia and Changxin Memory announced that the NaviX Ultra will be equipped with LPDDR5X memory with a speed of 10667Mbps. Changxin Memory stated that this is the first time that a domestically produced LPDDR5X chip with a speed of 10667Mbps has achieved mass production application, meaning that domestic mobile DRAM has entered the top rate commercial stage. Other partners of this device include Qualcomm Snapdragon, BOE, Samsung Semiconductor, and Goodix Technology.
